doc_title_en: Notice regarding Interim Dividend (Surplus Distribution) and Full-Year Dividend Forecast Revision (both increases)
doc_title_jp: 剰余金の配当（中間配当）および期末配当予想の修正（ともに増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: NIKKISO 2028 - Toward a Healthier World 中期経営計画に基づく累進配当方針、および通期業績予想の修正を踏まえた利益還元の強化

summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 30 ¥/share (from prior forecast 25 ¥), effective 2026-09-15. Full-year dividend forecast raised to 60 ¥/share (from 40 ¥ prior year), with period-end DOE expected at 2.3%. Progressive dividend policy targets DOE 2.5% by FY2028 and 3.0% long-term.
summary_jp: 中間配当30円/株（前回予想25円）、2026年9月15日発効。年間配当60円/株（前期40円）に修正。期末DOE約2.3%見込み。累進配当方針でFY2028年に2.5%、長期的に3.0%を目安。
tag_en: Dividend hike – interim 30 ¥/share (from 25 ¥) + FY-end 30 ¥/share (from 25 ¥) = 60 ¥/share annual (from 40 ¥) – DOE 2.3% at FY-end
tag_jp: 配当増額 – 中間30円/株（前回予想25円）+ 期末30円/株（前回予想25円）= 年間60円/株（前期実績40円）– 期末DOE約2.3%
